summary: Tested MLflow tracking + auto-retrain feature (PRD §10.4) on top of v1.0.0. All 15 backend pytest cases PASS (RBAC + drift + retrain + baseline pin). Frontend Playwright verified MLflowPanel renders on /portal with all 5 required data-testids for admin (mlflow-panel, mlflow-drift-status, mlflow-baseline-auc, mlflow-current-auc, mlflow-auc-drop, mlflow-retrain-button). Retrain button click triggers loading state + 'Retrain dispatched' toast. Viewer sees panel (read-only) but retrain button correctly hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC correctly enforced: POST /api/mlflow/retrain returns 403 for both viewer and analyst (admin-only) — matches PRD §10.4.
POST /api/mlflow/auto-check correctly allows both admin & analyst (403 for viewer).
Baseline pin (POST /api/mlflow/baseline/{run_id}) is admin-only and works as expected.
Drift-check response shape complete: status, baseline_auc, current_auc, auc_drop, threshold=0.05, recommend_retrain — all present and typed correctly.
MLflowPanel UI: all required data-testids present and visible on admin /portal; retrain button correctly hidden for viewer role via conditional render.

Note: current synthetic data is fully separable so baseline_auc=current_auc=1.0 and drift is always STABLE — drift trigger path can only be exercised via injected metric perturbation, not natural drift. Not a bug, but a testing limitation worth noting for future regression.
test_credentials: admin@c1b.com/admin123, analyst@c1b.com/analyst123, viewer@c1b.com/viewer123 — all verified working.
seed_data_creation: None. Retrain endpoint produced a new MLflow run during testing (now 3+ runs at AUC=1.0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_mlflow.py (15 tests covering /api/mlflow/{runs,latest,baseline,drift-check,retrain,retrain-status,auto-check,baseline/{run_id}} with RBAC). MLflowPanel testids: mlflow-panel, mlflow-drift-status, mlflow-baseline-auc, mlflow-current-auc, mlflow-auc-drop, mlflow-retrain-button (admin-only), mlflow-pin-{i}, mlflow-run-{i}, mlflow-skeleton. Retrain spawns a subprocess (~6s); use /api/mlflow/retrain-status to poll. Current AUC=1.0 (synthetic data fully separable) so DRIFT path is naturally untriggerable.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Feature implementation matches PRD §10.4 and all listed acceptance criteria in the review_request.
